article_title: Developing practitioner-scholars though university-school district research partnerships: Multiple perspectives on collaborative research
citation: Beth Tarasawa, Nicole Ralson, Jacqueline Waggoner. (2017). Developing practitioner-scholars though university-school district research partnerships: Multiple perspectives on collaborative research. Journal of Public Scholarship in Higher Education, 6, 94–107. https://eric.ed.gov/?q=Developing+practitioner-scholars+university-school+district+research+partnerships
title: Early kindergarten transition (EKT) program evaluation study conducted by the university–district partnership
description: The early kindergarten transition (EKT) program evaluation is the concrete research project through which the Multnomah County university–district partnership operated. According to the abstract, "This article details the early kindergarten transition (EKT) program evaluation study conducted by a university–district partnership," alongside district leadership testimony on the deliverables' utility. The evaluation served both as district-requested research and as a training context for practitioner-scholars doing rigorous evaluation work.
requirements: A university–district research partnership able to conduct evaluation work requested by the district
target_learners: practitioner-scholars in a university education program
examples: The abstract states the article details the EKT program evaluation study conducted by the partnership, with testimony from district leadership on the utility of the research deliverables.
